title: Server Launch
message: Welcome! Focus your early gems on unlocking your first hero slot.

title: First Guild War
message: Save at least 200 gems and hold your summon tickets — the war shop restocks today and the early buys give the best value.

title: Tower of Trials Opens
message: Bank your energy potions starting now. Do NOT auto-spend energy this week; you'll want a full stockpile for the day-7 climb.

title: Limited Hero Banner
message: Keep 300+ summon shards in reserve for the two-week banner. Reminder to not spend shards on the standard pool before this.
